name: Los Cerrillos
terms: Denominación de Origen Calificada, a step above DO for regions with a record of consistent quality. Only Rioja and Priorat hold it.
Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
A single-estate wine of high quality. A pago is a vineyard estate.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago in Argamasilla de Alba, Castilla-La Mancha. Its red wines are made from Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah and Petit Verdot.
